race.description: Daikin Australia Perfecting The Air Mdn Plate
race.comment: VICTORIA (13) goes on top after placing on debut at the Sunny Coast despite starting unwanted in betting. She had some interference in the lane but stuck on gamely. Draws well and that first race experience gives her a strong platform. Sharing a similar profile, BYE BYE CASTLE (2) is the main danger, having been beaten just under a length on debut also at the Sunny Coast after settling midfield and closing off nicely to finish within a length of the winner. Has been kept fresh and gets weight relief. The rise to 1400m should also suit. CAPTAIN REDCLAW (3) never looked likely on debut at Doomben but managed to make steady in-roads in the straight. The inside draw and softer assignment give him scope to improve sharply. Gelded PUHARICH (7) is next best.
